stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r: (i) 3 − i + 2i² − i³ = p + qi + ri² + i³ (ii) z₁ = 1 + 2i, z₂ = 2 − i; |z₁ + z₂|² = p, |z₁ − z₂|² = q, |z₁|² + |z₂|² = r (iii) If (4i⁴ + 5i⁴ + 6i⁶ + 7i)/(pi⁸ + 5i⁹ + qi^(10) + ri^(11)) = 1. Value of p = ____, q = ____, r = ____ (for each part)
derived: (i) q = 1, p − r = 1 (not unique; key's 3,1,2 fits) (ii) 10, 10, 10 (iii) as printed: p − q = 3, r = −2 (not unique)
correct_answer: (i) q = 1, p − r = 1 (e.g. 3, 1, 2) (ii) p = q = r = 10 (iii) underdetermined
reason: Three-part recap with separate answers, and parts (i)/(iii) are underdetermined (one real equation for p, r). Key (iii) p=4,q=6,r=7 fits only if numerator were 4i⁴+5i⁵+6i⁶+7i⁷ = −2−2i (print misprint).
